summary.zh: 愤怒更快且法力减半，所有伤害法术再省 25%，另加 4% 命中与更远射程。
summary.en: A faster, half-price Wrath, 25% off every damage spell, and 4% hit with more range on top.

pros.zh: 强化愤怒让愤怒的施法时间缩短 0.5 秒、法力消耗降低 50%，而愤怒正是你施放最多的法术。
pros.en: Improved Wrath removes 0.5 seconds and half the Mana cost from Wrath, which is the spell you cast most.

pros.zh: 月光让伤害法术的法力消耗降低 25%，这决定了你一管蓝是拉两次还是四次怪。
pros.en: Moonglow cuts 25% of the Mana cost of your damage spells, and that is the difference between two pulls and four.

pros.zh: 自然延伸让平衡系法术射程提高 20%、命中提高 4%，目标走到面前之前能多打几发。
pros.en: Nature's Reach adds 20% range and 4% hit to your Balance spells, so more casts land before the target reaches you.

pros.zh: 如果被打断的次数多于法力见底，可以把强化愤怒换成自然集中。
pros.en: Improved Wrath can be Nature's Focus instead if you are being interrupted more often than you are running out of Mana.

provenance.source: wowhandbook.com recommended builds, beta client data
provenance.notes: Beta build 1.60.1.70425 recommendations; may change before launch.
